tunnel.passage_other_detail: She states she did not experience a tunnel but was allowed to see/learn about it later (described as like a wormhole; light at end is brilliance of God).

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus identified via 'divine hands of Jesus.'
arrival.other_being_detail: Multiple 'Masters/ascended masters'; Metatron; 'council of 7'; threatening being associated with 'Pluto'; blazing golden eagle that merged with her.

environment.environment_other_detail: Upward/outward movement; suspended in atmosphere; multiple dimensions; planetary/solar systems; 'universal grid systems'; 'Universal Healing Center' (grid); black hole; very dark/evil place; later a dark-but-not-negative realm revealing 'Matrix of Creation'; council/meeting room; seated at a desk with a sacred text ('Akashic Records').

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Council/Masters decided to attempt a rare 'immediate reincarnation' after overturning a decision; they considered there was 'more they could do with me' than keep her on the other side; required her agreement to a 'new contract.'
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Described as 'immediate reincarnation' / 'rebirth' involving 'fire and water' and 'angel DNA' infusion; returned to the previous body with a 'frequency' keeping it alive.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Not framed as a single mission statement, but she reports being altered, given healing abilities/knowledge, and later working as a Holistic Wellness Practitioner; also given access to teachings/knowledge and messages from ascended people.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Assault/abduction implied: dragged away by multiple people; locked in a room; couldn't breathe; then 'was gone.'

person_demographics.occupation: Holistic Wellness Practitioner (post-NDE); traveled out of state for work at time of event (occupation not specified).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Ascended masters/dimensions; cosmic travel; 'Universal Healing Center' grid; 'Matrix of Creation'; Akashic Records; council of 7; dark/evil realm and negotiation for release.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel and no deceased relatives; immediate transition to meeting God/angelic guidance; extensive multi-dimensional journey; later dark/hellish episode; then council decision leading to return via 'immediate reincarnation.'
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reports moving upward and outward 'all at the same time' and mind being 'everywhere' and 'everything, simultaneously.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Blazing golden eagle merging with her body; being handed from Jesus to successive 'Masters' across dimensions; witnessing multicultural death rites; 'Universal Healing Center' grid and 'Matrix of Creation'; 'Akashic Records' shown by Metatron; 'council of 7' intervention; 'immediate reincarnation' into same body with 'angel DNA' infusion; dark 'Pluto' realm with negotiation/formula for release; post-return identity loss and extreme sensory sensitivity with claimed telepathy.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “mustn’t weep for the body, it's time to come with me.” / “the Eye of God” / “The Matrix of Creation” / “Akashic Records” / “They told me that I had earned the right to ascend.” / “I was not expected to return. It was my time to stay.” / “attempt an immediate reincarnation.” / “I lost my identity. I did not know who I was.”
